subject: Startup Boost: Accelerator credit approval & onboarding steps
messages:
From: Lena Morris <lena@vertexaccelerator.org>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Vertex cohort credit request — Orion Labs

Hi Priyom,

Congrats on the new program — excited to work with Redwood. We just confirmed Orion Labs for our Spring cohort (cohort 2026-03). As part of our partnership, we have an allocation of platform credits that we disburse to accepted companies. Orion has requested Redwood credits to accelerate their product demos during the build sprint.

Can you confirm what information you need from us to process the credit issuance? Our standard asks are: company acceptance letter, a brief company profile, and a contact for billing/PO if needed. I attached the acceptance PDF for the cohort.

Thanks — cc'ing Samir (Orion) so he sees the loop.

Best,
Lena Morris
Program Manager, Vertex Accelerator
Vertex Accelerator
Attachment: orion_vertex_acceptance.pdf (application/pdf)

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Lena Morris <lena@vertexaccelerator.org>
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vertex cohort credit request — Orion Labs

Hi Lena / Samir —

Thanks for the acceptance doc, and congrats to Orion. We can issue a self-serve promo code (one-time redemption) tied to the cohort allocation. To proceed we need: 1) brief company profile (one page), 2) confirm whether they need prepaid billing or will use self-serve billing after credits are exhausted, and 3) an expected kickoff date for using the credits.

If you want the fastest path, Samir can submit the profile via the onboarding form and I can generate the promo code immediately — it usually shows up in the Redwood Console under Billing > Credits within 10 minutes of issuance. If there are procurement/PO constraints, cc your billing contact and we will route to our finance team.

Next steps I propose:
- Samir uploads the one-page profile to the shared Drive link below.
- I generate the cohort promo code and send it to Samir and Vertex ops.
- aisha, can you confirm if we should apply any usage caps for this cohort?

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Vertex/Orion-Onboarding-Checklist

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Khatri <samir@orionlabs.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Morris <lena@vertexaccelerator.org>, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vertex cohort credit request — Orion Labs

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — attaching the one-pager and a company info sheet. We prefer self-serve billing after credits are used; no PO on our side. The cohort kickoff is planned for March 10, 2026 and the team will start demo work that week. 

Attachments: orion_company_profile_onepager.pdf, orion_company_info_sheet.xlsx

Would appreciate the code before EOD on Wednesday if possible so we can schedule the environment prep.

—Samir
Co-founder, Orion Labs
samir@orionlabs.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Samir Khatri <samir@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Lena Morris <lena@vertexaccelerator.org>, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vertex cohort credit request — Orion Labs

Samir —

All set. Reviewed the one-pager and acceptance doc; approved under the Vertex Accelerator partner allocation. I created a one-time promo code and applied the cohort cap: $15,000 in credits, valid for 90 days. Redemption is self-serve; Samir, follow these steps: 1) Sign into your Redwood Console, 2) go to Billing > Apply promo code, 3) enter code STARTUP-VERGE-2026-001. The credits will appear under Billing > Credits and will be consumed before any billing occurs.

Code: STARTUP-VERGE-2026-001
Allocation: $15,000 (USD)
Valid: 2026-03-03 through 2026-06-01
Cap: Single-redeem per account; not transferable

I've also uploaded the promo record to our shared Drive and added the credit issuance to deal VG-2026-0458 in HubSpot. Finance has been notified but not required a PO since Orion opted into self-serve billing.

Aisha — we did not set a token-per-minute usage cap; let me know if you want a soft alert at $10k consumed.

Samir / Lena — happy to run a 20-minute onboarding on Thursday for API keys, model selection, and best-practice batching — suggested time 11:00 AM PT. Let me know if that works and I will send calendar invite.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: promo_record_STARTUP-VERGE-2026-001.json (metadata)
